e.title: ActurHire 薪资进阶指南
e.summary: ActurHire 2026 精算师薪资进阶：职业阶段的薪资演进参考
e.body:
ActurHire「Actuary Salary Progression: 2026 Pay Guide」：精算师职业阶段的薪资进阶指南——按职业阶段/年限的薪资演进（美国市场）。对 RIAA：精算薪资的职业阶段维度——与 [[acturhire-salary-guide]]（按考试薪资）、[[acturhire-h1-2026-market]]（就业市场研究）、[[dw-simpson-salary-survey]]（薪资调查）配套：ActurHire 薪资三件套（考试/阶段/市场）；理解「精算薪资怎么进阶」的参考；长期职业规划的薪资路径。

e.body_en:
ActurHire 'Actuary Salary Progression: 2026 Pay Guide': a salary-progression guide by career stage/tenure (US market). For RIAA: the career-stage dimension of actuarial salaries — with [[acturhire-salary-guide]] (salary by exams), [[acturhire-h1-2026-market]] (job-market research) and [[dw-simpson-salary-survey]] (salary survey) it forms the ActurHire salary trio (exams/stages/market); understand the reference of 'how actuarial salaries progress'; a salary path for long-term career planning.
